title: Report: Chicago Bears Jonah Jackson week-to-week with a hip flexor

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Chicago Bears Jonah Jackson week-to-week with a hip flexor
sources.description: According to a report from ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler, Chicago Bears starting right guard Jonah Jackson is dealing with a hip flexor and is considered week-to-week. Jackson left Sunday’s win against the Atlanta Falcons in the second half and was ruled doubtful to return. Second-year pro Luke Newman entered the game for Jackson and finished the game. […]
